item.title: Verbose beta 217
item.description:
More words spelled right

  • Verbose spells about 330 more words right without any setup: AI tools and apps, places, people, brands, film and video gear, and business terms, such as NVIDIA, Albuquerque, H.264, and EBITDA.
  • Dictation fixes everyday mix-ups that are always wrong, such as “could of been” and “sneak peak.” Turn them off with Built-in vocabulary in Settings.
